name: Saudi Qaid Transport Company (Saudia Alqaid Transport Co)
note: Makkah-based private bus-transport company founded in 2015 (hajj, school, tourist and club transport; qaid.sa). Its chairman of the board is Salah Qaid bin Qaid (Hajj & Umrah Forum participant profile, January 2024). No state body or state fund found in the chain (searched 2026-10-03).
